hataratNedarim:
[[NOTE]]It is customary to perform Hatarat Nedarim (annulment of vows) on the eve of Rosh Hashanah and the eve of Yom Kippur, and it is good for there to be ten men serving as the ones who annul, who study halacha. Some also have the custom of doing this annulment forty days before Rosh Hashanah.

Shimu na rabbotenu, hare anachnu shoalim umebaqshim hattara min haqqadosh baruk hu, umin toratenu haqqedosha, umibbet din shel mala umibbet din shel matta, umimmaalatkem, shettattiru lanu ulenapshenu, lenashenu ulebanenu, ulekal anshe betenu ulekal hannilvim elenu, kol mine nedarim shennadarnu al atzmenu o al acherim bekol min leshon neder, vekol mine nezirut veissurim sheasarnu al atzmenu o al acherim bekol lashon sheyyihyeh.

Vekol hahaskamot sheqqibbalnu al atzmenu o shehiskamnu apillu bemachashaba, laasot ezo mitzva bekol tzad veopen sheyyihyeh. uminhagim shehinhagnu et atzmenu laasot ezo mitzva o perishut o seyagim ugedarim o chumrot venidre zeruzin bekol tzad veopen sheyyihyeh, venahagnu haddabar hahu shalosh peamim o yoter, velo perashnu sheyyihyeh beli neder. vekol mine shebuot shennishbanu bekol lashon sheyyihyeh, al atzmenu o al acherim bekol tzad veopen sheyyihyeh.

Vegam hare anachnu mebaqshim mimmaalatkem lehattir lanu ulekal bene betenu kol mine alot shemattot charamim erurim nidduyim unezipot vekinnuyim, vekol mine qelalot sheqqillalnu et atzmenu o et acherim, o acherim sheqqillelu otanu ben behaqitz ben bachalom. ubiprat im abarnu al otam arbaa veesrim debarim shebbet din menaddin alehem, al kullam o al miqtzatam, o apillu al echad mehem, o sheabarnu al shum dabar shechayyabin alayv shum qelala, o shum gezera raa.

Vekol mine chalomot raim shechalamnu al atzmenu o al acherim, o acherim shechalemu alenu raa, vekol mine pitronim raim al hachalomot sheppatarnu leatzmenu o laacherim, o acherim sheppateru raa lanu. vekol mine mesirat din shemmasarnu al atzmenu o al acherim, o acherim shemmaseru alenu. vekol mine pitchon peh leraa sheppatachnu pinu al atzmenu o al acherim, o acherim sheppatechu pihem leraa alenu.

Vekol mine gezerot qashot veraot, vekol mine ayin hara, vekol mine machashabot zarot vehirhurim raim, vekol mine gaava vekaas veqappedanut, veqina vesina vetacharut, vekol mine hazkarat hashshem lebattala, vekol mine debarim asurim sheyyatzeu mippinu. al hakkol hare anachnu mitcharetim alehem charata gemura, umebattelim otam bittul gamur.

Veen anachnu tohim umitcharetim chas veshalom al hammitzvot umaasim tobim sheasinu vesheqqiyyamnu o sheqqibbalnu o shennahagnu, ella hare anachnu mitcharetim al sheqqibbalnu hainyanim hahem bechiyyub neder o shebua, vaanachnu yereim lenapshenu shello nikkashel chas veshalom baavon nedarim ushebuot, umeqabbelim alenu lashub bitshuba shelema. umeatta anachnu mebaqshim mimmaalatkem lehattir lanu alehem hattara gemura.

[[NOTE]]The ones who annul respond:

Birshut qudsha berik hu ushekineteh, ubirshut bet din shel mala, ubirshut bet din shel matta, ubirshut toratenu haqqedosha, ubirshut sanhedre gedola, ubirshut sanhedre qetanna, muttarim yihyu kol qelalot alot ushemattot vacharamim veerurim venidduyim unezipot ubittuyim vekinnuyim vekol debarim raim vekol chalomot raim upitronim raim umesirat din upitchon peh leraa, vekol mine debarim asurim, vekol mine gezerot qashot veraot, vekol mine ayin raa, vekol machashabot zarot vehirhurim raim, vekol mine gaava vekaas veqappedanut veqina vesina vetacharut, vekol mine nedarim ushebuot unezirot veissurin veqabbalot uminhagim, shehusemu alekem o al shum echad mibbene battekem.

Veken qelalot sheqqillelu etkem acherim, o sheqqillaltem et atzmekem, o sheqqillaltem et acherim, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben bekaas ben beratzon, ben bekavvana ben shello bekavvana, ben bachalom ben behaqitz, bekol open sheyyihyeh, o shennitchayyabtem shum qelala o erur o cherem o nidduy o nezipa o shum gezera raa beezeh tzad veopen sheyyihyeh. al hakkol, meatta umeakshayv anachnu mattirin umebattelin mealekem et hakkol birshut qudsha berik hu ushekineteh, ubet dino, pamalya shel mala upamalya shel matta.

Muttarim lakem, muttarim lakem, muttarim lakem. sheruyim lakem, sheruyim lakem, sheruyim lakem. mechulim lakem, mechulim lakem, mechulim lakem. en kan qelalot. en kan charamim. en kan nidduyim. en kan nezipot. en kan bittuyim. en kan debarim raim. en kan chalomot raim. en kan pitronim raim. en kan mesirat din. en kan pitchon peh leraa. en kan machashabot zarot vehirhurim raim. en kan gezerot qashot veraot. en kan ayin hara denashim. en kan ayin hara shel anashim. en kan ayin hara desoneim udeohabim. en kan debarim asurim. en kan qabbalot. en kan minhagim. kullam yihyu betelim umebuttalim, vachashubim kacheres hannishbar, ukedabar sheen bo mammash, shebitin ushebiqin, la sheririn vela qayyamin.

Vekol mine ayin hara yuseru meal kol yisrael umealekem umibbattekem, veyushleku bimtzulot yam, kakkatub: velo yidbaq beyadeka meuma min hacherem, lemaan yashub Adonai mecharon appo, venatan leka rachamim verichamka vehirbeka, kaasher nishba laaboteka.

Anna Adonai, hitmalle berachamim, veyikbeshu rachameka et kaaska, veyiggollu rachameka al middoteka, veyitmattequ haddinin meal ammeka yisrael umealenu. uzekor lanu aqedato shel yitzchaq abinu alayv hashshalom, keillu epro tzabur umunnach al gabbe hammizbeach, vehabbet beepro lehatztzilenu lanu ulekal yisrael achenu mikkol ra.

Ukeshem shemmaskimim umattirim lakem bet din shel matta, kak yaskimu veyattiru lakem bet din shel mala. vekol haqqelalot vekol hachalomot raim, vekol pitronim raim, vekol mesirat din, vekol pitchon peh leraa, vekol mine gezerot qashot veraot, vekol mine debarim asurim, vekol mine machashabot zarot vehirhurim raim, kullam yithappeku lakem letoba velibraka, kakkatub: velo aba Adonai eloheka lishmoa el bilam, vayyahapok Adonai eloheka leka et haqqelala libraka, ki ahebeka Adonai eloheka. uketib: veattem haddebeqim baAdonai elohekem, chayyim kullekem hayyom. aseh lemaan shemeka, aseh lemaan yemineka, aseh lemaan torateka, aseh lemaan qedushshateka. yihyu leratzon imre pi vehegyon libbi lepaneka, Adonai tzuri vegoali. Adonai oz leammo yitten, Adonai yebarek et ammo bashshalom.

[[NOTE]]Afterward, those requesting the annulment say this declaration:

Hare anachnu moserim modaa lipne haqqadosh baruk hu, velipne bet din shel mala velipne bet din shel matta, velipnekem, umebattelim meatta vead olam kol min qabbala im neqabbel alenu, minnedarim ushebuot unezirot veissurin veqonamot vacharamot vehaskamot veqabbala balleb, bekol lashon, bekol tzad veopen sheyyihyeh, ben behaqitz ben bachalom, chutz minnidre qabbalat taanit im neqabbel.

Utenay modaa zo yihyeh qayyam ad olam, velo yitbattel beshum tzad veopen sheyyihyeh. veim nishkach litnay modaa zo tok kede dibbur leneder o lishbua, venachazor lindor o lishshaba mechamat ezo sibba shettihyeh, ben beones ben beratzon, ben bekavvana ben shello bekavvana, bekol lashon — hare anachnu mebattelim otam bittul gamur, umatnim alehem sheyyihyu kullam betelim umebuttalim, la sheririn vela qayyamin, velo yihyu chalin kelal.

Veod anachnu moserim modaa lipnekem bekol libbenu ubekol napshenu, vahare anachnu mebattelim meatta vead olam kol min maaseh shel issur im naaseh chas veshalom, veken kol min dibbur shel issur im yetze mippinu chas veshalom. vegam kol mine machashabot zarot vehirhurim raim, vegam kol mine gaava vekaas veqappedanut, veqina vesina vetacharut, meatta hare anachnu mitcharetim alehem, umatnim alehem sheyyihyu kullam betelim umebuttalim meiqqaran.

Veod anachnu moserim modaa lipnekem, rabbotenu, shekkal machashaba raa vehirhur ra ureuta delibba, im yaaleh belibbenu umochenu, ubiprat beet hattepilla vetalmud tora, beezeh tzad veopen sheeno likbod uretzon habbore yitbarak, meakshayv anachnu mebattelim otam machashabot vehirhurim raim ureuta delibba shehem neged retzon qudsha berik hu ushekineteh, bittul gamur kacheres hannishbar.

Veatta anachnu mebaarim umepareshim baer heteb, vaanachnu megallim datenu uretzonenu bekol libbenu, ki retzonenu umaavayyenu vekavvanatenu laabod et boreenu, elohe abraham elohe yitzchaq veyisrael, aboda shelema, aboda tamma, bemachashaba vedibbur umaaseh, beyira veahaba vesimcha rabba kedat mah laasot.

[[NOTE]]Afterward, the ones who annul say the acceptance of this declaration:

Birshut qudsha berik hu ushekineteh, qibbalnu mesirat hammodaa hazzot asher mesartem gupekem napshekem ruchakem venishmatkem leillat kol haillot vesibbat kol hassibbot. vekol mah shettaasu mehayyom neged mesirat hammodaa hazzot, hen bemaaseh hen bedibbur vehen bemachashaba, anachnu mebattelim oto hammaaseh o haddibbur o hammachashaba birshut qudsha berik hu ushekineteh, velo yaasu bakem shum roshem kelal.

igeretHaramban:
Shama beni musar abika, veal tittosh torat immeka. vetihyu regilim ledabber kol deberekem benachat, lekol adam ubekol et, ubazzeh tinnatzelu min hakkaas, shehu midda raa lehachti et bene adam. kaasher ameru rabbotenu zikronam libraka: kol hakkoes — kol mine gehinnom sholetim bo.

Vetinnatzelu min hakkaas, taaleh al libbeka middat haanava, ki hi midda toba mikkol hammiddot hattobot. ukemo sheameru rabbotenu zikronam libraka: leolam yehe adam anav kehillel veal yehe qappedan keshammay. ubaabur zot tagel vetismach lebabeka beyirateka, kakkatub: yere Adonai ashre kol yere Adonai haholek bidrakayv.

Veatta beni, heve ragil ledabber kol debareka benachat, lekol adam, bekol et, ubezeh tinnatzel min hakkaas shehu chet gadol, shehishva oto hakkatub laaboda zara. ukeshettinnatzel min hakkaas taaleh al libbeka middat haanava shehi hattoba shebbammiddot hattobot. shenneemar: eqeb anava yirat Adonai.

Ubaabur haanava, taaleh al libbeka yirat chet, ki bihyot haadam anav shapal ruach lipne kol adam, venibhal venirash mecheteo, ki miggedullat Adonai yitbarak, umiggodel kebod torato, yachshob belibbo tamid: ani omed lipne borei, vekol bene haolam keayin veepes negdo.

Utedabber kol debareka benachat, verosheka kapup, veeneka yabbitu lematta laaretz velibbeka lemala. veal tabbit bipne haadam bedabberka immo. vekol adam yihyeh chashub beeneka, kemo shettachshob oto gadol mimmeka. im chakam hu o ashir — aleka lekabbedo, veim rash hu veatta ashir mimmennu, o chakam mimmennu — chashob belibbeka sheatta chayyab vehu zakkay, sheim hu chote — hu shogeg, veatta mezid.

Ubekol debareka, maaseka umachsheboteka, ubekol et, chashob belibbeka keillu atta omed lipne haqqadosh baruk hu, ushekinato aleka, ki kebodo male haolam. veyihyu debareka beema ubeyira keebed lipne rabbo. velo titnaheg baasiyya shel derek eretz, velo baasaqeka im bene adam, ella kemo shettitnaheg bebet hakkeneset bitpillateka.

Veatta beni, heve zahir liqrot seper hazzeh tamid, kemo shettiqra battepilla, vetiqra oto paam achat beshabbat, vetishmor kol haamur bo, ki bo tasub el Adonai eloheka.

tefilatHashela:

Atta hu Adonai elohenu ad shello barata haolam, veatta hu elohenu mishshebbarata haolam, umeolam vead olam atta el. ubarata olameka begin leishtemodaa elahutak beemtzaut torateka haqqedosha, kemo sheameru rabbotenu zikronam libraka, "bereshit", bishbil tora ubishbil yisrael, ki hem ammeka venachalateka asher bacharta bahem mikkol haummot, venatatta lahem torateka haqqedosha, veqerabtam leshimka haggadol. veal qiyyum haolam veal qiyyum hattora ba lanu mimmeka Adonai elohenu shene tzivvuyim: katabta betorateka peru urebu, vekatabta betorateka velimmadtem otam et benekem. vehakkavvana bishtehen echat, ki lo letohu barata ki im lashebet, velikbodeka barata yatzarta ap asita, kede shennihyeh anachnu vetzeetzaenu vetzeetzae kol ammeka bet yisrael yodee shemeka velomede torateka.

Ubeken abo eleka Adonai melek malke hammelakim, veappil techinnati, veenay leka teluyot ad shettechonneni vetishma tepillati lehazmin li banim ubanot. vegam hem yipru veyirbu hem ubenehem ubene benehem ad sop kol haddorot, letaklit shehem vaani kullanu yaasqu betorateka haqqedosha, lilmod ulelammed lishmor velaasot uleqayyem et kol dibre talmud torateka beahaba, vehaer enenu betorateka vedabbeq libbenu bemitzvoteka leahaba uleyira et shemeka.

Abinu ab harachaman, ten lekullanu chayyim arukkim uberukim, mi kamoka ab harachamim zoker yetzurayv lechayyim berachamim, zakerenu lechayyim nitzchiyyim, kemo shehitpallel abraham abinu "lu yichyeh lepaneka", upereshu rabbotenu zikronam libraka, beyirateka.

Ki al ken, bati lebaqqesh ulechannen millepaneka sheyyehe zari vezera zari ad olam zera kasher. veal yimmatze bi ubezari ubezera zari ad olam shum pesul vashemetz, ak shalom veemet vetob veyashar beene elohim ubeene adam, veyihyu baale tora, mare miqra, mare mishna, mare talmud, mare raza, mare mitzva, mare gomele chasadim, mare middot terumiyyot, veyaabduka beahaba ubeyira penimit, lo yira chitzonit, veten lekol geviyya ugeviyya mehem de machsorah bekabod, veten lahem beriut vekabod vakoach, veten lahem qoma veyopi vechen vachesed, veyihyeh ahaba veachva veshalom benehem, vetazmin lahem zivvugim hagunim mizzera talmide chakamim, mizzera tzaddiqim, vegam zivvugam yihyu kemotam kekal asher hitpallalti alehem, ki zikkaron echad oleh lekan ulekan.

Atta Adonai yodea kol taalumot, ulepaneka niglu matzpune libbi, ki kavvanati bekol elleh lemaan shimka haggadol vehaqqadosh ulemaan torateka haqqedosha, al ken aneni Adonai aneni, baabur haabot haqqedoshim abraham yitzchaq veyaaqob. ubiglalam toshia banim lihyot haanapim domim leshorsham, ubaabur david abdeka regel rebii bammerkaba, hameshorer beruach qodsheka.

Shir hammaalot ashre kol yere Adonai haholek bidrakayv: yegia kappeka ki tokel ashreka vetob lak: eshteka kegepen poriyya beyarkete beteka baneka kishtile zetim sabib leshulchaneka: hinneh ki ken yeborak gaber yere Adonai: yebarekka Adonai mitztziyyon ureeh betub yerushalayim kol yeme chayyeka: ureeh banim lebaneka shalom al yisrael:

Anna Adonai shomea tepilla yequyyam banu happasuq: vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai, ruchi asher aleka udebaray asher samti bepika, lo yamushu mippika umippi zaraka umippi zera zaraka amar Adonai meatta vead olam.

Anna elohay, zakkeni leqayyem mah shetztzivvitanu: velimmadtem otam et benekem ledabber bam. veyitqayyem bi miqra shekkatub udebaray asher samti bepika lo yamushu mippika umippi zaraka umippi zera zaraka amar Adonai meatta vead olam. veyihyu banay more horaot kesherot beyisrael leshem shamayim. velo yittu yamin ushemol midderek hayeshara udebar sheqer yerachaqu. velo yimmatzeu bam mum velo midda raa miqqetannam vead gedolam.

Yehi ratzon millepaneka sheolid banim ubanot velo yamut shum achad mibbanay bechayyay, velo achat mibbenotay bechayyay. eqqach nashim lebanay, velo yamutu neshotehem miqqotzer shanim. veezkeh lehassi benotay laanashim hagunim vetzaddiqim, velo yamutu balehen beqotzer shanim. velo tippater zugati beqotzer shanim.

Vihi ratzon millepaneka Adonai shettazmin lekol achad mibbanay et bat zugo, ulekal achat mibbenotay et ben zugah hameyuchad lekol achad mehem, velo yaqdimem acher berachamim, velo yiddachu mippene acherim. veyolidu banay ubenotay bemazzal tob ubeshaa toba. velo yechsar lahem leolam mazon veterep betam. vehatztzilem mimmeoraot upeullot raot. veyishmeru et berit qodesh mikkol tuma veerva. vehashken ben ish leishto ahaba veachva veshalom vereut, veken ben qerobehem. veezkeh lazun otam beqatnutam bekabod, beli cherpa ubizzayon. veyihyu toratam ummanutam bekabod. veezkeh lirot besimchatam. velo yihyeh bahem aqar vaaqara umeshakkela. veyimtzeu chen vesekel tob beene elohim veadam. veyihyu shomeim beqol abihem veimmam verabbanehem, veach qatan yishma legadol vikabbedehu. ubenotay tihyena yapot venaot ubaalot sekel vachasidut, tzenuot tzidqaniyyot vachasidot meuttarot bemiddot tobot, tihyena shelemot beli mum. ubarek maaseh yaday, kede sheezkeh leharbot lahem mohar umattan karauy libne gilan. umehem yetzeu perot tobot ubanim tzaddiqim zokim umezakkim lekol yisrael, amen ken yehi ratzon.

petichatEliyahu:
Vihi noam adonay elohenu alenu, umaaseh yadenu konena alenu, umaaseh yadenu konenehu.

Petach eliyyahu hannabi zakur letob veamar: ribbon alemin deant hu chad vela bechushban, ant hu illaa al kol illain, setima al kol setimin, let machashaba tepisa bak kelal. ant hu deappeqat eser tiqqunin, veqarinan lon eser sepiran, leanhaga behon alemin setimin dela itgalyayn vealemin deitgalyayn, ubehon itkasseat mibbene nasha. veant hu deqashir lon umeyached lon, ubegin deant millegav, kol man deaprish chad min chabreh meillen eser sepiran, itchashib leh keillu aprish bak. veillen eser sepiran innun azelin kesidran, chad arik vechad qatzar vechad benoni. veant hu deanhig lon, velet man deanhig lak, la leela vela letatta vela mikkol sitra. lebushin tiqqant lon, deminnehon parechin nishmatin libne nasha. vekamma gupin tiqqanta lon, deitqeriu gupa legabbe lebushin dimkasyayn alayyhu, veitqeriu betiqquna da: chesed deroa yemina, gebura deroa semala, tiperet gupa, netzach vehod teren shoqin, yesod siyyuma degupa ot berit qodesh, malkut peh tora shebbeal peh qarinan lah. chokma mocha ihi machashaba millegav, bina libba ubah halleb mebin, veal illen teren ketib: hannistarot laAdonai elohenu. keter elyon ihu keter malkut, vaaleh ittemar: maggid mereshit acharit. veihu qarqapta ditpille. millegav ihu ot yud" ot he" ot vav" veot he" deihu orach atzilut, ihu shaqyu deilana bidrooy veanpoy, kemayya deashqe leilana veitrebe behahu shaqyu.

Ribbon alemin, ant hu illat haillot vesibbat hassibbot, deashqe leilana behahu nebiu, vehahu nebiu ihu kenishmata legupa, deihu chayyim legupa. ubak let dimyon velet deyoqena mikkol ma dilgav ulebar. ubarata shemayya veara, veappeqat minnehon shimsha vesihara vekokebayya umazzale, ubeara ilanin vedishin veginneta deeden veisbin vechevan veopin venunin ubeirin ubene nasha, leishtemodea behon illain, veek yitnahagun behon illain vetattain, veek ishtemodean meillain vetattain, velet deyada bak kelal. ubar minnak let yichuda beillain vetattain, veant ishtemoda adon al kolla. vekol sepiran kol chad it leh shem yedia, ubehon itqeriu malakayya. veant let lak shem yadua, deant hu memalle kol shemahan, veant hu shelimu dekullehu. vekad ant tistalleq minnehon, ishtearu kullehu shemahan kegupa bela nishmata. ant chakkim velav bechokma yedia, ant hu mebin velav mibbina yedia, let lak atar yedia, ella leishtemodea tuqpak vechelak libne nasha, uleachazaa lon ek itnaheg alema bedina uberachame, deinnun tzedeq umishpat kepum obadehon dibne nasha. din ihu gebura. mishpat ammuda deemtzaita. tzedeq malkuta qaddisha. mozene tzedeq teren samke qeshot. hin tzedeq ot berit. kolla leachazaa ek itnehig alema. abal lav deit lak tzedeq yedia deihu din, velav mishpat yedia deihu rachame, velav mikkol illen middot kelal.

Qum rabbi shimon veyitchaddeshun millin al yedak, deha reshuta it lak legallaa razin temirin al yedak, veityehib reshu legallaa leshum bar nash ad kean.

Qam rabbi shimon patach veamar: leka Adonai haggedulla vehaggebura veku'. illain shimu, innun demikin dechebron, veraya mehemana ittearu mishshintekon. haqitzu verannenu shokene apar — illen innun tzaddiqayya deinnun missitra dehahu deittemar beh ani yeshena velibbi er, velav innun metim, ubegin da ittemar behon haqitzu verannenu veku'. raya mehemana, ant veabhan, haqitzu verannenu leitaruta dishkineta deihi yeshena begaluta. dead kean tzaddiqayya kullehu demikin veshinta bechorehon. ha yahabat shekineta telat qalin legabbe raya mehemana leitteara leh: qum raya mehemana, deha alak ittemar qol dodi dopeq legabbay bearba atvan dileh, vayyema behon: pitchi li achoti rayati yonati tammati, deha tam avonek bat tziyyon, lo yosip lehaglotek — sheroshi nimla tal. may nimla tal? ella amar qudsha berik hu: ant chashebat demiyyoma deitcharab be maqdesha, dealena bebeta dili vealena beyishuba — lav haki, dela alena kol zemanna deant begaluta. ha lak simana: sheroshi nimla tal. h" shekineta begaluta, shelimu dilah vechayyim dilah ihu tal, veda ihu ot yud" ot he" ot vav" veot he" ihi shekineta. dela mechushban tal" ella ot yud" ot he" veot vav" desalleqin atvan lechushban tal", deihi malya lishkineta miggebiu dekal meqorin illain. miyyad qam raya mehemana veabhan qaddishin immeh. ad kan raza deyichuda.

Baruk atta Adonai elohenu melek haolam, asher yatzar et haadam bechokma, ubara bo neqabim neqabim, chalulim chalulim, galuy veyadua lifne kisse kebodeka, sheim yissatem echad mehem, o im yippateach echad mehem, ee efshar lehitqayyem afillu shaa echat. baruk atta Adonai, rofe kol bassar umafli laasot:

Baruk atta Adonai elohenu melek haolam, hannoten lassekvi bina, lehabchin ben yom uben layela:

talitTefilin.talitLeshemYichud: leshem yichud qudsha berik hu ushechinteih, bidchilu urechimu, urechimu udchilu, leyachada shem Yud-Qei beVav-Qei beyichuda shelim (Adonai) beshem kol Yisrael. hareni mukan leqayyem mitzvat ase lilbosh tallit metzuyyetzet kehilchatah, kemo shetzivvanu Adonai elohenu betorato haqedosha: [[HALI]](Bemidbar 15:38)[[/HALI]] veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe bigdehem. kede shennizkor kol mitzvotav laasotam shenneemar [[HALI]](Bemidbar 15:39)[[/HALI]] ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai vaasitem otam. vahareni mukan levarech al atifat hattallit ketiqqun rabotenu zichronam livracha. vahareni mekavven liftor bivracha zo gam tallit haqqatan sheallay. kede laasot naachat ruach leyotzrenu velaasot ratzon borenu. viyhi | noam Adonai elohenu alenu umaase yadenu konena alenu umaase yadenu konenehu.
talitTefilin.talitBracha: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melech haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit:
talitTefilin.tefilinLeshemYichud: leshem yichud qudsha berik hu ushechinteih, bidchilu urechimu, urechimu udchilu, leyachada shem Yud-Qei beVav-Qei beyichuda shelim (Adonai) beshem kol Yisrael. hareni mukan leqayyem mitzvat ase lehaniach tefillin beyadi uverishi, kemo shetzivvanu Adonai elohenu: uqshartam otam leot al yedchem vehayu letotafot ben enechem. vetzivvanu haqqadosh baruk hu lehaniach arba parshiyyot ellu sheyesh bahem yichud shemo viytziat mitzrayim al hazzeroa keneged hallev, veal harosh keneged hammoach, kede shennizkor nissim veniflaot sheasa immanu. vahareni mukan levarech habberacha shettiqnu rabotenu zichronam livracha al mitzvat hattefillin, vahareni mekavven liftor bivracha zo tefillin shel yad utefillin shel rosh, veyaale lefaneka Adonai elohenu velohe abotenu keillu kivvanti bechol hakkavvanot harreuyot lechavven bahanachat hattefillin uvabberacha. lehiyot naachat ruach leyotzrenu velaasot ratzon borenu. viyhi noam Adonai elohenu alenu, umaase yadenu konena alenu, umaase yadenu konenehu.
talitTefilin.tefilinBracha: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melech haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotav, vetzivvanu lehaniach tefillin:
talitTefilin.tefilinBrachaAltNote: If speech intervened between laying the hand-tefillin and the head-tefillin in a way that counts as an interruption, the blessing is said over the head-tefillin instead (Ben Ish Chai, Vayera 6).
talitTefilin.tefilinBrachaAlt: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melech haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotav, vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin:
talitTefilin.tefilinFingerWrapNote: After laying the head-tefillin, one should immediately finish laying the hand-tefillin with three windings around the middle finger, making one winding around its middle joint and two around its lower joint, reciting at the time of these windings (Ben Ish Chai, Vayera 16):
talitTefilin.tefilinFingerWrapVerses: veerastich li leolam, veerastich li betzedeq uvemishpat uvechesed uverachamim. veerastich li beemuna, veyadaat et Adonai.
talitTefilin.tefilinKadeshLiNote: After laying the tefillin, one recites the portions Kadesh Li and Vehaya Ki Yeviacha to complete the four portions [of the tefillin] each day; one who cannot say them before prayer says them afterward (Ben Ish Chai, Vayera 25).
talitTefilin.tefilinKadeshLi: Vaydabber Adonai el Moshe lemor: qadesh li chol bechor peter chol rechem bivne Yisrael, baadam uvabbehema, li hu. Vayomer Moshe el haam: zachor et hayyom hazze asher yetzatem mimmitzrayim mibbet avadim, ki bechozeq yad hotzi Adonai etchem mizze, velo yeachel chametz. hayyom attem yotzeim, bechodesh haaviv. vehaya ki yeviacha Adonai el eretz hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehachivvi vehayvusi asher nishba laavoteka latet lach eretz zavat chalav udevash, veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze. shivat yamim tochal matzot, uvayyom hasshevii chag laAdonai. matzot yeachel et shivat hayyamim, velo yerae lecha chametz velo yerae lecha seor bechol gevuleka. vehiggadta levinecha bayyom hahu lemor, baavur ze asa Adonai li, betzeti mimmitzrayim. vehaya lecha leot al yadecha ulezikkaron ben enecha, lemaan tihye torat Adonai befica, ki beyad chazaqa hotziacha Adonai mimmitzrayim. veshamarta et hachuqqa hazzot lemoadah, miyyamim yamima.
talitTefilin.tefilinVehayaKiYeviacha: vehaya ki yeviacha Adonai el eretz hakkenaani, kaasher nishba lecha uleavoteka, unetanah lach. vehaavarta chol peter rechem laAdonai, vechol peter sheger behema asher yihye lecha hazzecharim laAdonai. vechol peter chamor tifde veseh, veim lo tifde vaarafto, vechol bechor adam bevaneka tifde. vehaya ki yishaleka vincha machar lemor mah zzot, veamarta elav bechozeq yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim mibbet avadim. vayehi ki hiqsha paro leshallechenu, vayaharog Adonai kol bechor beeretz mitzrayim, mibbechor adam vead bechor behema, al ken ani zoveach laAdonai kol peter rechem hazzecharim, vechol bechor banay efde. vehaya leot al yadecha uletotafot ben enecha, ki bechozeq yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim.
talitTefilin.twoParshiotNote: The next two portions are the two remaining portions written in the tefillin - Shema and Vehaya Im Shamoa - which are also recited as part of the Shacharit Shema; included here for one who completes all four portions on their own right after laying tefillin.

tikunChatzot.rubricNote: Tikun Chatzot is not said on Friday night, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret, or Chol HaMoed Pesach. Tikun Rachel is not said - Tikun Leah is said instead - on days when Tachanun is not said, during the days of the Omer, the Ten Days of Repentance, after the molad before Rosh Chodesh (even though confession is said that same day), in a house of mourning, a house of a groom, for the father of a baby boy on the day of his own personal Yom Tov, and in Eretz Yisrael during the Shemitah year. Women do not say Tikun Chatzot, and once dawn has broken one no longer says Tikun Chatzot, neither Tikun Rachel nor Tikun Leah. At midday during the Three Weeks, Tikun Rachel is said.
tikunChatzot.ana: Anna Adonai elohenu veelohe abotenu. tavo lefaneka tefillatenu. veal titallam malkenu mittechinnatenu. sheen anachnu azze fanim uqeshe oref lomar lefaneka Adonai elohenu veelohe abotenu tzaddiqim anachnu velo chatanu. aval chatanu. avinu. pashanu. anachnu vaavotenu veanshe betenu: ashamnu. bagadnu. gazalnu. dibbarnu dofi velashon hara. heevinu. vehirshanu. zadnu. chamasnu. tafalnu sheqer umirma. yaatznu etzot raot. kizzavnu. kaasnu. latznu. maradnu. marinu devareka. niatznu. niafnu. sararnu. avinu. pashanu. pagamnu. tzararnu. tziarnu av vaem. qishinu oref. rashanu. shichatnu. tiavnu. tainu vetiatanu. vesarnu mimmitzvoteka umimmishpateka hattovim velo shava lanu. veatta tzaddiq al kol habba alenu. ki emet asita. vaanachnu hirshanu:
tikunChatzot.mahNomar: Mah nomar lefaneka yoshev marom, umah nesapper lefaneka shochen shechaqim, halo kol hannistarot vehanniglot atta yodea, atta yodea raze olam, vetaalumot sitre kol chay, atta chofes kol chadre vaten, roe cheliyot valev, en davar neelam mimmeka, veen nistar minneged eneka: yehi ratzon millefaneka, Adonai elohenu veelohe abotenu, shettimchol lanu et kol chattotenu, utechapper lanu et kol avonotenu, vetimchol vetislach lechol peshaenu:
tikunChatzot.rachelZechorHashem: ZechOr Adonai me hayah lanu, habbita uree et cherpatenu. nachalatenu nehepecha lezarim, battenu lenochrim. yetomim hayinu veen av, immotenu kealmanot. memenu bechesef shatinu, etzenu bimchir yavou. al tzavvarenu nirdafnu, yaganu velo hunach lanu. mitzrayim natannu yad, ashshur lisboa lachem. avotenu chatu veenam, vaanachnu avonotehem savalnu. avadim mashelu vanu, poreq en miyyadam. benafshenu navi lachmenu, mippene cherev hammidbar. orenu ketannur nichmaru, mippene zalafot raav. nashim betziyyon innu, betulot beare yehuda. sarim beyadam nitlu, pene zeqenim lo nehdaru. bachurim techon nasau, unearim baetz kashalu. zeqenim missahar shavatu, bachurim minneginatam. shavat mesos libbenu, nehpach leevel mecholenu. nafela ateret roshenu, oy na lanu ki chatanu. al ze hayah dave libbenu, al elle chashechu enenu. al har tziyyon sheshshamem, shualim hillechu vo. atta Adonai leolam teshev, kisaacha ledor vador. lamma lanetzach tishkachenu, taazvenu leorech yamim. hashivenu Adonai eleka venashuva, chaddesh yamenu keqedem. ki im maos meastanu, qatzafta alenu ad meod. hashivenu Adonai eleka venashuva, chaddesh yamenu keqedem:
tikunChatzot.rachelHabetMishamayim: Habbet mishamayim uree, mizzevul qodsheka vetifarteka. ayye qinateka ugvuroteka, hamon meeka verachameka elay hitappaqu. ki atta avinu, ki avraham lo yedaanu veyisrael lo yakkiranu, atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemeka. lamma tateenu Adonai midderakeka, taqshiach libbenu miyyirateka, shuv lemaan avadeka shivte nachalateka. lammitzar yareshu am qodsheka, tzarenu boseSu miqdasheka.
tikunChatzot.rachelVeatah: Veatta Adonai avinu atta, anachnu hachomer veatta yotzrenu, umaase yadeka kullanu. al tiqtzof Adonai ad meod, veal laad tizkor avon, hen habbet na ammeka chullanu. are qodsheka hayu midbar, tziyyon midbar hayeta, yerushalayim shemama. bet qodshenu vetifartenu, asher hilluka avotenu, hayah lisrefat esh, vechol machamaddenu hayah lecharba. haal elle titappaq Adonai, techeshe utaannenu ad meod.
tikunChatzot.rachelOyLiNote: At the end of the verses of lament, one says (pointing with the finger, 45):
tikunChatzot.rachelOyLi: Oy li al galut hashshechina, oy li al churban bet hammiqdash, oy li al serefat hattora, oy li al haregat hatzaddiqim, oy li al chillul shemo haggadol vetorato haqqedosha, oy li al ki gavar oyev, oy li al tzaar kol haolamot, oy li al tzaar haavot haqqedoshim vehaimmahot haqqedoshot, oy li al tzaar hanneviim vehachasidim vehatzaddiqim asher began eden, oy li al tzaaro shel mashiach. avonotenu hittu elle ufeshaenu heericu qitzenu, vechattotenu manu hattov mimmennu, oy lahem labbanim shegalu meal shulchan avihem ze kamma orech yamim veshanim rabbim veraim, kol dor shello nivnah bet hammiqdash beyamav keillu necherav beyamav:
tikunChatzot.rachelAlChomotayich: Al chomotayich yerushalayim, hifqadti shomerim, kol hayyom vechol hallayla tamid lo yechesu, hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem. veal tittenu domi lo, ad yechonen veaad yasim et yerushalayim tehilla baaretz. nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo, im etten et deganech od maachal leoyevayich, veim yishtu vene nechar tiroshech asher yagaat bo. ki measpav yochluhu vehillelu et Adonai, umeqabbetzav yishtuhu bechatzrot qodshi.
tikunChatzot.rachelAtahTakum: Atta taqum terachem tziyyon, ki et lechennah, ki va moed. ki ratzu avadeka et avaneha, veet afarah yechonenu. bone yerushalayim Adonai, nidche yisrael yechannes:

roshChodeshExtra.berichShmei: Berik shemeh shemeh demare alma, berik kitrach veatrach. yehe reutach, im ammach yisrael leAlam, ufurqan yeminach achze leammach bevet miqdashach, leamtuye lana mittuv nehorach, ulqabbela tzelotana berachame. yehe raava qodamach detorich lan chayyin betivu, veleheve ana avdach peqida bego tzaddiqayya, lemircham alay ulmintar yati, veyat kol di li, vedi leammach yisrael. ant hu zan lechola umefarnes lechola. ant hu shallit al kola, ant hu deshallit al malchayya, umalchuta dilach hi. ana avda dequdsha berik hu, desagidna qammeh miqamme diyqar orayteh bechol iddan veiddan. la al enash rachitzna, vela al bar elahin semichna, ella beelaha dishmayya, dehu elaha diqshot, veorayteh qeshot, unevioh qeshot, umasge lemeevad tavvan uqeshot, beh ana rachitz velishmeh yaqqira qaddisha ana emar tushbechan. yehe raava qodamach detiftach libbi beorayetach, (vetihav li benin dichrin deavdin reutach) vetashlim mishalin delibbay velibba dechol ammach yisrael letav ulchayyin ulshelam amen:

kaddishDerabbanan:
Yitgaddal veyitqaddash shemeh rabba. [Amen] Bealma di bera, kireuteh, veyamlik malkuteh, veyatzmach purqaneh, viqareb meshicheh. [Amen] Bechayyekon ubeyomekon ubechayye dechol bet yisrael, baagala ubizman qarib, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehe shemeh rabba mebarak lealam ulealme almayya yitbarak. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasse. Veyithaddar. Veyitalle. Veyithallal shemeh dequdsha, berik hu. [Amen] Leella min kol birkata shirata, tushbechata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen]

Al yisrael veal rabbanan. Veal talmidehon veal kol talmide talmidehon. Deasqin beoraita qaddishta. Di beatra hadein vedi bechol atar vaatar. Yehe lana ulehon ulekon china vechisda verachame. Min qodam mare shemayya vearea veimru amen. [Amen]

Yehe shelama rabba min shemayya. Chayyim vesaba vishua venechama. Vesheizaba urefua ugeulla useslicha vechappara verevach vehatzala lanu ulechol ammo yisrael. Veimru amen. [Amen]

Ose shalom bimromayv. Hu berachamayv yaase shalom alenu veal kol ammo yisrael. Veimru amen. [Amen]

[Amen] Bechayyekon ubeyomekon ubechayye dechol bet yisrael, baagala ubizman qarib, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehe shemeh rabba mebarak lealam ulealme almayya yitbarak. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasse. Veyithaddar. Veyitalle. Veyithallal shemeh dequdsha, berik hu. [Amen] Leella min kol birkata shirata, tushbechata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen]

Titqabbal tzelotana ubautana, im tzelothon ubaathon dechol bet yisrael, qodam abuna debishmayya vearea, veimru amen. [Amen]

Yehe shelama rabba min shemayya. Chayyim vesaba vishua venechama. Vesheizaba urefua ugeulla useslicha vechappara verevach vehatzala lanu ulechol ammo yisrael. Veimru amen. [Amen]

pitumHaketoretShort: Atta hu Adonai elohenu, shehiqtiru abotenu lefaneka et qetoret hassammim, bizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam, kaasher tzivvita otam al yad mosheh nebiaka, kakkatub betorataka: Vayyomer Adonai el mosheh: qach leka sammim, natap ushechelet vechelbena, sammim ulebona zakka, bad bebad yihye. Veasita otah qetoret roqach maase roqeach, memullach tahor qodesh. Veshachaqta mimmenna hadeq, venatatta mimmenna lifne haedut beohel moed asher ivvaed leka shamma, qodesh qadashim tihye lakem. Veneemar: vehiqtir alayv aharon qetoret sammim babboqer babboqer, behetibo et hannerot yaqtirenna. Ubehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaqtirenna, qetoret tamid lifne Adonai ledorotekem: Tanu rabbanan: pittum haqqetoret ketzad? Shelosh meot veshishshim ushemona manim hayu bah. Shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha keminyan yemot hachamma, maneh bekol yom, machatzito babboqer umachatzito baereb. Ushelosha manim yeterim, shemmehem maknis kohen gadol, venotel mehem melo chopnayv beyom hakkippurim, umachaziran lemakteshet beereb yom hakkippurim, kede leqayyem mitzvat daqqa min haddaqqa. Veachad asar sammanim hayu bah, veellu hen: hatztzori. b vehatztzipporen. g vehachelbena. d vehallebona, mishqal shibim shibim maneh. h mor, v uqetzia, z veshibbolet nerd, ch vekarkom, mishqal shishsha asar shishsha asar maneh. t haqqosht shenem asar, y qillupa shelosha, y qinnamon tisha, borit karshina tisha qabbin. Yen qaprisin sein telata veqabbin telata, veim lo matza yen qaprisin, mebi chamar chivvar attiq. Melach sedomit roba. Maale ashan kol shehu. Rabbi natan habbabli omer: af kippat hayyarden kol shehi, im natan bah debash pesalah, veim chisser achat mikkol sammaneha, chayyab mita: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hatztzori eno ella serap hannotep meatze haqqetap. Borit karshina, lemma hi baa? Kede leshappot bah et hatztzipporen, kede shettehe naa. Yen qaprisin, lemma hu ba? Kede lishrot bo et hatztzipporen, kede shettehe azza. Vahalo me raglayim yapin lah? Ella sheen maknisin me raglayim bammiqdash mippene hakkabod: Tanya, rabbi natan omer: keshehu shocheq, omer: hadeq hetev, hetev hadeq! Mippene shehaqqol yafe labbesamim. Pittemah lachatzain, kesherah. Leshalish ulerabia, lo shamanu. Amar rabbi yehuda: ze hakelal, im kemiddatah, kesherah lachatzain, veim chisser achat mikkol sammaneha, chayyab mita: Tane bar qappara: achat leshishshim o leshibim shana, hayeta baa shel shirayim lachatzain. Veod tane bar qappara: illu haya noten bah qartob shel debash, en adam yachol laamod mippene rechah. Velamma en mearebin bah debash? Mippene shehattora amera: ki kol seor vechol debash lo taqtiru mimmennu ishe laAdonai: Adonai tzebaot immanu, misgab lanu elohe yaaqob sela. Adonai tzebaot, ashre adam boteach bak. Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu. Veareba laAdonai minchat yehuda virushalayim, kime olam ukeshanim qadmoniyyot:

hallel.opening_bracha: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melek haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv, vetzivvanu ligmor et hahallel:

psalms.text: Halleluyah (Tehillim 113:1-2). Hallelu abde Adonai, hallelu et shem Adonai. Yehi shem Adonai meborak, meatta vead olam. Mimmizrach shemesh ad mebo'o, mehullal shem Adonai. Ram al kol goyim Adonai, al hashamayim kebodo. Mi kaAdonai elohenu, hammagbihi lashabet. Hammashpili lirot, bashamayim ubaaretz. Meqimi meafar dal, meashpot yarim ebyon. Lehoshibi im nedibim, im nedibe ammo. Moshibi aqeret habbayit, em habbanim semecha, halleluyah.

Betzet (Tehillim 114:1-2) Yisrael mimmitzrayim, bet yaaqob meam loez. Hayeta yehuda leqodsho, yisrael mamshelotayv. Hayyam raa vayyanos, hayyarden yissob leachor. Heharim raqedu keelim, gebaot kibene tzon. Ma leka hayyam ki tanus, hayyarden tissob leachor. Heharim tirqedu keelim, gebaot kibene tzon. Millifne adon chuli aretz, millifne eloha yaaqob. Hahofki hatzur agam mayim, challamish lemaeyeno mayim.

Lo (Tehillim 115:1-2) lanu Adonai, lo lanu, ki leshimka ten kabod, al chasdeka al amitteka. Lamma yomeru haggoyim, ayye na elohehem. Velohenu bashamayim, kol asher chafetz asa. Atzabbehem kesef vezahab, maase yede adam. Peh lahem velo yedabberu, enayim lahem velo yiru. Oznayim lahem velo yishmau, af lahem velo yerichun. Yedehem velo yemishun, raglehem velo yehalleku, lo yehgu bigronam. Kemohem yihyu osehem, kol asher boteach bahem. Yisrael betach baAdonai, ezram umagginnam hu. Bet aharon bitchu baAdonai, ezram umagginnam hu. Yire Adonai bitchu baAdonai, ezram umagginnam hu.

Adonai zecharanu yebarek, yebarek et bet yisrael, yebarek et bet aharon. Yebarek yire Adonai, haqqetannim im haggedolim. Yosef Adonai alekem, alekem veal benekem. Berukim attem laAdonai, ose shamayim vaaretz. Hashamayim shamayim laAdonai, vehaaretz natan libne adam. Lo hammetim yehalelu Yah, velo kol yorde duma. Vaanachnu nebarek Yah, meatta vead olam, halelu Yah.

Ahabti (Tehillim 116:1-2) ki yishma Adonai et qoli tachanunai. Ki hitta ozno li, ubeyamai eqra. Afafuni chebel mavet, umetzare sheol metzauni, tzara veyagon emtza. Ubeshem Adonai eqra, anna Adonai malleta nafshi. Channun Adonai vetzaddiq, velohenu merachem. Shomer petaim Adonai, dalloti veli yehoshia. Shubi nafshi limnuchayki, ki Adonai gamal alayki. Ki chillatzta nafshi mimmavet, et eni min dima, et ragli middechi. Ethallek lifne Adonai, beartzot hachayyim. Heemanti ki adabber, ani aniti meod. Ani amarti bechofzi, kol haadam kozeb.

Ma ashib laAdonai, kol tagmulohi alay. Kos yeshuot essa, ubeshem Adonai eqra. Nedaray laAdonai ashallem, negda na lechol ammo. Yaqar beene Adonai, hammavta lachasidayv. Anna Adonai ki ani abdeka, ani abdeka ben amateka, pittachta lemoserai. Leka ezbach zebach toda, ubeshem Adonai eqra. Nedaray laAdonai ashallem, negda na lechol ammo. Bechatzrot bet Adonai, betokeki yerushalayim, halleluyah.
Hallelu (Tehillim 117:1-2) et Adonai kol goyim, shabbechuhu kol haummim. Ki gabar alenu chasdo, veemet Adonai leolam, halleluyah.

Hodu (Tehillim 118:1) laAdonai ki tob, ki leolam chasdo. Yomar na yisrael, ki leolam chasdo. Yomeru na bet aharon, ki leolam chasdo. Yomeru na yire Adonai, ki leolam chasdo. Min hammetzar qarati Yah, anani bammerchab Yah. Adonai li lo ira, ma yaase li adam. Adonai li beozeray, vaani ereh besoneai. Tob lachasot baAdonai, mibbetoach baadam. Tob lachasot baAdonai, mibbetoach bindibim. Kol goyim sebabuni, beshem Adonai ki amilam. Sabbuni gam sebabuni, beshem Adonai ki amilam. Sabbuni kidborim, doachu keesh qotzim, beshem Adonai ki amilam. Dacho dechitani linpol, vaAdonai azarani. Ozzi vezimrat Yah, vayehi li lishua. Qol rinna vishua beohole tzaddiqim, yemin Adonai osa chayil. Yemin Adonai romema, yemin Adonai osa chayil. Lo amut ki echye, vaasapper maase Yah. Yassor yisserani Yah, velammavet lo netanani. Pitchu li shaare tzedeq, abo bam ode Yah. Ze hashaar laAdonai, tzaddiqim yabou bo. Odeka ki anitani, vattehi li lishua. Odeka ki anitani, vattehi li lishua. Eben maasu habbonim, hayeta lerosh pinna. Eben maasu habbonim, hayeta lerosh pinna. Meet Adonai hayeta zot, hi niflat beenenu. Meet Adonai hayeta zot, hi niflat beenenu. Ze hayyom asa Adonai, nagila venismecha bo. Ze hayyom asa Adonai, nagila venismecha bo. Anna Adonai hoshia na, anna Adonai hoshia na. Anna Adonai hatzlicha na, anna Adonai hatzlicha na. Baruk habba beshem Adonai, berachnukem mibbet Adonai. Baruk habba beshem Adonai, berachnukem mibbet Adonai. El Adonai vayyaer lanu, isru chag baabotim ad qarnot hammizbeach. El Adonai vayyaer lanu, isru chag baabotim ad qarnot hammizbeach. Eli atta veodeka, elohai aromemeka. Eli atta veodeka, elohai aromemeka. Hodu laAdonai ki tob, ki leolam chasdo. Hodu laAdonai ki tob, ki leolam chasdo.

hallel.closing_yehalelucha: Yehalleluka Adonai elohenu kol maaseka, vachasideka vetzaddiqim ose retzoneka veammeka bet yisrael, kullam berinna yodu vibarku vishabbechu vifaaru et shem kebodeka, ki leka tob lehodot, uleshimka naim lezammer, umeolam vead olam atta el: Baruk atta Adonai, melek mehullal battishbachot:

amidah19.name: Abot
amidah19.text: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu velohe abotenu, elohe abraham, elohe yitzchaq, velohe yaaqob. Hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora, el elyon, gomel chasadim tobim, qone hakkol, vezoker chasde abot, umebi goel libne benehem lemaan shemo beahaba:
amidah19.teshuvaInsert: Zochrenu lechayyim, melek chafetz bachayyim, katebenu besefer chayyim, lemaanak elohim chayyim.

amidah19.name: Geburot
amidah19.text: Atta gibbor leolam Adonai, mechaye metim atta, rab lehoshia.
amidah19.text2: Mechalkel chayyim bechesed, mechaye metim berachamim rabbim, somek noflim, verofe cholim, umattir asurim, umeqayyem emunato lishene afar. Mi kamoka baal geburot, umi dome lak, melek memit umechaye umatzmiach yeshua.
amidah19.teshuvaInsert: Mi kamoka ab harachaman, zoker yetzurayv berachamim lechayyim.

amidah19.name: Qedushat Hashem
amidah19.text: Atta qadosh veshimka qadosh, uqedoshim bechol yom yehaleluka sela:

amidah19.name: Bina
amidah19.text: Atta chonen leadam daat umelammed leenosh bina. Vechannenu meittak chochma bina vadaat: Baruk atta Adonai, chonen haddaat:

amidah19.name: Teshuba
amidah19.text: Hashibenu abinu letorateka, veqarbenu malkenu laabodateka, vehachazirenu bitshuba shelema lefaneka: Baruk atta Adonai, harotze bitshuba:

amidah19.name: Selicha
amidah19.text: Selach lanu abinu ki chatanu, mechol lanu malkenu ki pashanu, ki el tob veselach atta: Baruk atta Adonai, channun hammarbe lislo'ach:

amidah19.name: Geulla
amidah19.text: Ree na beonyenu, veriba ribenu, umaher legoalenu geulla shelema lemaan shemeka, ki el goel chazaq atta: Baruk atta Adonai, goel yisrael:

amidah19.name: Refua
amidah19.text: Refaenu Adonai venerafe, hoshienu venivvashea, ki tehillatenu atta, vehaale aruka umarpe lechol tachaluenu ulechol makobenu ulechol makkotenu. Ki el rofe rachman veneeman atta:
amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, rofe chole ammo yisrael:

season.summer: Barekenu Adonai elohenu bechol maase yadenu, ubarek shenatenu betalle ratzon beracha undaba, utehi acharitah chayyim vesaba veshalom kashanim hattobot libracha, ki el tob umetib atta umbarek hashanim: Baruk atta Adonai, mebarek hashanim:
season.winter: Barek alenu Adonai elohenu et hashana hazzot veet kol mine tebuatah letoba, veten tal umatar libracha al kol pene haadama, verave pene tebel vesabba et haolam kullo mittubak, umalle yadenu mibirchoteka umeosher mattenot yadeka. Shamera vehatzila shana zo mikkol dabar ra, umikkol mine mashchit umikkol mine puranut, vease lah tiqva toba veacharit shalom. Chus verachem aleha veal kol tebuatah uferoteha, ubarecha begishme ratzon beracha undaba, utehi acharitah chayyim vesaba veshalom. Kashanim hattobot libracha, ki el tob umetib atta umbarek hashanim. Baruk atta Adonai, mebarek hashanim:

amidah19.name: Qibbutz Galuyot
amidah19.text: Teqa beshofar gadol lecherutenu, vesa nes leqabbetz galuyotenu, veqabbetzenu yachad mearba kanfot haaretz leartzenu: Baruk atta Adonai, meqabbetz nidche ammo yisrael:

amidah19.name: Hashabat Hammishpat
amidah19.text: Hashiba shofetenu kebarishona, veyoatzenu kebattechilla, vehaser mimmennu yagon vaanacha. Umeloch alenu mehera atta Adonai lebadka, bechesed uberachamim, betzedeq ubemishpat:
amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat:

amidah19.name: Birkat Hamminim
amidah19.text: Lamminim velammalshinim al tehi tiqva, vechol hazzedim kerega yobedu, vechol oyebeka vechol soneeka mehera yikkaretu, umalchut harishaa mehera teaqqer uteshabber utechallem vetachniem bimhera beyamenu:
amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, shober oyebim umachnia zedim (minim):

amidah19.name: Al Hatzaddiqim
amidah19.text: Al hatzaddiqim veal hachasidim, veal sheerit ammeka bet yisrael, veal peletat bet soferehem, veal gere hatzedeq vealenu, yehemu na rachameka Adonai elohenu, veten sachar tob lechol habbotechim beshimka beemet, vesim chelqenu immahem, uleolam lo nebosh ki beka batachnu, veal chasdeka haggadol beemet nishannu: Baruk atta Adonai, mishan umibtach latzaddiqim:

amidah19.name: Binyan Yerushalayim
amidah19.text: Tishkon betok yerushalayim iraka kaasher dibbarta, vechisse david abdeka mehera betocha takin, ubene ota binyan olam bimhera beyamenu: Baruk atta Adonai, bone yerushalayim:

amidah19.name: Malchut Bet David
amidah19.text: Et tzemach david abdeka mehera tatzmiach, veqarno tarum bishuateka, ki lishuatka qivvinu kol hayyom: Baruk atta Adonai, matzmiach qeren yeshua:

amidah19.name: Shomea Tefilla
amidah19.text: Shema qolenu, Adonai elohenu, ab harachaman, rachem alenu, veqabbel berachamim uberatzon et tefillatenu, ki el shomea tefillot vetachanunim atta, umillefaneka malkenu reqam al teshibenu, channenu vaanenu ushema tefillatenu,
amidah19.faslInsert: Anenu abinu anenu beyom tzom hataanit hazze, ki betzara gedola anachnu. Al tefen lerishenu, veal titallam malkenu mibbaqqashatenu. Heye na qarob leshavatenu, terem niqra eleka atta taane, nedabber veatta tishma, kaddabar shenneemar: vehaya terem yiqrau vaani eene, od hem medabberim vaani eshma: ki atta Adonai pode umatzil, veone umerachem bechol et tzara vetzuqa:
amidah19.tail: Ki atta shomea tefillat kol pe:

amidah19.name: Aboda
amidah19.text: Retze Adonai elohenu beammeka yisrael velitfillatam shee, vehasheb haaboda lidbir beteka, veisshe yisrael utefillatam mehera beahaba teqabbel beratzon, utehi leratzon tamid abodat yisrael ammeka:

yaaleVeyavo.head: Elohenu velohe abotenu, yaale veyabo, veyaggia veyerae, veyeratze veyishshama, veyippaqed veyizzacher, zichronenu vezichron abotenu, zichron yerushalayim iraka, vezichron mashiach ben david abdaka, vezichron kol ammeka bet yisrael lefaneka, lifleta, letoba, lechen, lechesed ulerachamim, lechayyim tobim uleshalom, beyom
yaaleVeyavo.pesach: Chag hammatzot hazze, beyom miqra qodesh hazze.
yaaleVeyavo.sukkot: Chag hassukkot hazze, beyom miqra qodesh hazze.
yaaleVeyavo.tail: Lerachem bo alenu ulehoshienu. Zochrenu Adonai elohenu bo letoba, ufoqdenu bo libracha, vehoshienu bo lechayyim tobim, bidbar yeshua verachamim. Chus vechannenu, vachamol verachem alenu, vehoshienu ki eleka enenu, ki el melek channun verachum atta:

amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, hammachazir shechinato letziyyon:

amidah19.name: Hodaa
amidah19.text: (During the blessing of "Modim," bow at "Modim" and straighten up at the Name (Ben Ish Chai, Beshalach 21)) Modim anachnu lak, sheatta hu Adonai elohenu velohe abotenu leolam vaed, tzurenu tzur chayyenu umagen yishenu atta hu, ledor vador node leka unesapper tehillateka, al chayyenu hammesurim beyadeka, veal nishmotenu hapqudot lak, veal nisseka shebbechol yom immanu, veal nifleoteka vetobotecha shebbechol et, ereb vaboqer vetzahorayim. Hattob, ki lo chalu rachameka, hammerachem, ki lo tammu chasadeka, ki meolam qivvinu lak:

alHanissim.head: Al hannissim veal happurqan veal haggeburot veal hatteshuot veal hannifleot veal hannechamot sheasita laabotenu bayyamim hahem bazzeman hazze:
alHanissim.chanukah: Bimeh Mattityah ben Yochanan kohen gadol Chashmonai ubanayv, keshe'ameda malchut yavan harshaa al ammeka yisrael, leshakecham torataka ulehaabiram mechuqqe retzonaka. Veatta berachameka harabbim amadta lahem beet tzaratam, rabta et ribam, danta et dinam, naqamta et niqmatam, masarta gibborim beyad challashim, verabbim beyad meattim, ureshaim beyad tzaddiqim, uteme'im beyad tehorim, vezedim beyad oseqe torateka. Leka asita shem gadol veqadosh beolamka, uleammeka yisrael asita teshua gedola ufurqan kehayyom hazze. Veachar kach bau baneka lidbir beteka, ufinnu et hechaleka, vetiharu et miqdasheka, vehidliqu nerot bechatzrot qodsheka, veqabeu shemonat yeme chanukka ellu behallel ubehodaa, veasita immahem nissim venifleot venode leshimka haggadol sela:
alHanissim.purim: Bime mordechai veester beshushan habbira, keshe'amad alehem haman harasha, biqqesh lehashmid laharog uleabbed et kol hayyehudim minnaar vead zaqen taf venashim beyom echad, bishlosha asar lechodesh shenem asar hu chodesh adar, ushelalam laboz. Veatta berachameka harabbim heferta et atzato veqilqalta et machshabto, vahashebota lo gemulo berosho, vetalu oto veet banayv al haetz, veasita immahem nes vafele venode leshimka haggadol sela:

amidah19.tail: Veal kullam yitbarak, veyitromam, veyitnasse, tamid, shimka malkenu, leolam vaed. Vechol hachayyim yoduka sela:
amidah19.teshuvaInsert: Uketob lechayyim tobim kol bene briteka.
amidah19.tail2: Viyhalelu vivarechu et shimka haggadol beemet leolam ki tob, hael yeshuatenu veezratenu sela, hael hattob:
amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, hattob shimka uleka nae lehodot:

amidah19.name: Shalom
amidah19.text: Sim shalom toba uberacha, chayyim chen vachesed verachamim, alenu veal kol yisrael ammeka. Ubarechenu abinu kullanu keechad beor paneka, ki beor paneka natatta lanu Adonai elohenu tora vechayyim, ahaba vachesed, tzedaqa verachamim, beracha veshalom. Vetob beeneka lebarechenu ulebarek et kol ammeka yisrael, berob oz veshalom:
amidah19.teshuvaInsert: Ubesefer chayyim, beracha veshalom, ufarnasa toba vishua venechama, ugezerot tobot, nizzacher venikkateb lefaneka, anachnu vechol ammeka bet yisrael, lechayyim tobim uleshalom.
amidah19.seal: Baruk atta Adonai, hamebarek et ammo yisrael bashalom. Amen:

tachanun.midot13: El erek appayim atta ubaal harachamim. Gedullat rachameka vachasadeka hodata leanav miqqedem. Vechen katub betorataka. Vayyered Adonai beanan vayyityatzeb immo sham vayyiqra beshem Adonai: Vesham neemar: vayyaabor Adonai al panayv vayyiqra, Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun, erek appayim verab chesed veemet. Notzer chesed laalafim, nose avon vafesha vechattaa, venaqqe: Rachum vechannun, chatanu lefaneka rachem alenu vehoshienu:
tachanun.afterNefilat:
Adonai elohe yisrael shub mecharon appeka. Vehinnachem al haraa leammeka:

Abinu malkenu, abinu atta. Abinu malkenu en lanu melek ella atta. Abinu malkenu rachem alenu: Abinu malkenu channenu vaanenu ki en banu maasim. Ase immanu tzedaqa vachesed lemaan shimka haggadol vehoshienu: Vaanachnu lo neda ma naase, ki aleka enenu.

Zechor rachameka Adonai vachasadeka, ki meolam hemma: Yehi chasdeka Adonai alenu, kaasher yichalnu lak: Al tizkor lanu avonot rishonim, maher yeqaddemunu rachameka, ki dallonu meod: Ezrenu beshem Adonai, ose shamayim vaaretz: Channenu Adonai channenu, ki rab sabanu buz: Berogez rachem tizkor. Berogez ahaba tizkor. Berogez aqeda tizkor. Berogez temimut tizkor: Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu: Ki hu yada yitzrenu, zachur ki afar anachnu: Ozrenu elohe yishenu al debar kebod shemeka, vehatzilenu vechapper al chattotenu lemaan shemeka:

Elohenu velohe abotenu. Al taas immanu kala, tochez yadeka bammishpat. Bebo tochecha negdeka, shemenu missifreka al temach. Gishteka lachaqor musar, rachameka yeqademu rogzeka. Dallut maasim beshureka, qareb tzedeq meeleka. Horenu, bezaaqenu lak, tzav yeshuatenu bemafgia. Vetashib shebut ohole tam, petachayv ree ki shamemu. Zechor naamta, edut lo tishachach mippi zaro. Chotam teuda tattir, sodeka sim belimmudeka. Tabbur agan hassahar, na al yechsar hammazeg. Yah, da et yisrael asher yedauka, magger et haggoyim asher lo yedauka. Ki tashib libbitzaron, lechudim asire hattiqva.

Ma nomar lefaneka yoshheb marom, uma nesapper lefaneka shochen shechaqim, halo hannistarot vehanniglot atta yodea, atta yodea raze olam, vetaalumot sitre kol chay, atta chofes kol chadre baten, roe chelayot valeb. En dabar neelam mimmeka, veen nistar minneged eneka:

Yehi ratzon millefaneka Adonai elohenu velohe abotenu, shettimchol lanu et kol chattotenu, utechapper lanu et kol avonotenu, vetimchol vetislach lechol pesaenu, vesalachta laavonenu ulechattatenu unechaltanu:

Selach lanu abinu ki chatanu, mechol lanu malkenu ki pashanu: Ki atta Adonai tob veselach, verab chesed lechol qoreeka: Lemaan shimka Adonai, veselachta laavoni ki rab hu: Lemaan shimka Adonai techayyeni, betzidqateka totzi mitzara nafshi: Adonai tzebaot immanu, misgab lanu elohe yaaqob sela: Adonai tzebaot, ashre adam boteach bak: Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu: Hashibenu Adonai eleka venashuba, chaddesh yamenu keqedem:

Vehu rachum yechapper avon velo yashchit, vehirba lehashib appo velo yair kol chamato: Atta Adonai lo tichla rachameka mimmenni, chasdeka vaamitteka tamid yitzeruni: Hoshienu Adonai elohenu veqabbetzenu min haggoyim lehodot leshem qodsheka, lehishtabbeach bithillateka: Im avonot tishmar Yah, Adonai mi yaamod: Ki immeka hasselicha, lemaan tivvare: Lo kachataenu asa lanu, velo kaavonotenu gamal alenu: Im avonenu anu banu, Adonai ase lemaan shemeka: Zechor rachameka Adonai vachasadeka, ki meolam hemma: Yaanka Adonai beyom tzara, yesaggebeka shem elohe yaaqob: Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu: Abinu malkenu, channenu vaanenu ki en banu maasim. Ase immanu tzedaqa kerob rachameka, vehoshienu lemaan shemeka:

Veatta Adonai elohenu asher hotzeta et ammeka meeretz mitzrayim beyad chazaqa, vattaas leka shem kehayyom hazze, chatanu rashanu: Adonai kechol tzidqoteka yashob na appeka vachamateka meiraka yerushalayim har qodsheka, ki bachataenu ubaavonot abotenu, yerushalayim veammeka lecherpa lechol sebibotenu: Veatta shema elohenu el tefillat abdeka veel tachanunayv, vehaer paneka al miqdasheka hashamem, lemaan Adonai: Hate elohai ozneka ushema, peqach eneka uree shomemotenu, vehair asher niqra shimka aleha, ki lo al tzidqotenu anachnu mappilim tachanunenu lefaneka, ki al rachameka harabbim: Adonai shemaa, Adonai selacha, Adonai haqshiba veasa al teachar, lemaanka elohai, ki shimka niqra al iraka veal ammeka:

Abinu ab harachaman, hareenu ot letoba veqabbetz nefutzotenu meearba kanfot haaretz. Yakiru veyedeu kol haggoyim ki atta Adonai abinu atta. Anachnu hachomer veatta yotzrenu umaase yadeka kullanu:

Abinu malkenu, tzurenu vegoalenu, chusa Adonai al ammeka veal titten nachalateka lecherpa limshol bam goyim, lamma yomeru baammim ayye elohehem: Yadanu Adonai ki chatanu, veen mi yaamod baadenu ella shimka haggadol yaamod lanu beet tzara. Ukerachem ab al banim rachem alenu. Chamol al ammeka verachem al nachalateka. Chusa na kerob rachameka channenu malkenu vaanenu. Leka Adonai hatzedaqa oseh nifleot bechol et vaet. Habbet na vehoshia na tzon marieteka. Al yimshol banu qetzef ki leka Adonai hayeshua bak tochaltenu. Eloha selichot, anna selach na. Ki el tob veselach atta:

Anna melek rachum vechannun, zechor vehabbet liberit ben habbetarim. Vetiraeh lefaneka aqedat yachid. Ulemaan yisrael abinu. Al taazbenu abinu. Veal titteshenu malkenu veal tishkachenu yotzrenu. Veal taas immanu kala begalutenu. Ki el melek channun verachum atta:

En kamoka channun verachum elohenu. En kamoka el erek appayim verab chesed veemet. Hoshienu verachamenu meraash umerogez hatzilenu: Zechor laabadeka, leabraham leyitzchaq ulyaaqob, al tefen el qeshi haam hazze veel risho veel chattato: Shub mecharon appeka vehinnachem al haraa leammeka: Vehaser mimmennu makkat hammavet ki rachum atta. Ki chen darkeka laasot chesed chinnam bechol dor vador: Anna Adonai hoshia na, anna Adonai hatzlicha na: Anna Adonai anenu beyom qareenu: Leka Adonai qivvinu. Leka Adonai chikkinu. Leka Adonai neyachel al techeshe utaanenu. Ki naamu goyim abeda tiqvatam. Kol berek leka tikra vechol qoma lefaneka tishtachave:

Hapoteach yad bitshuba leqabbel poshim vechattaim. Nibhala nafshenu merob itzebonenu. Al tishkachenu netzach quma vehoshienu. Al tishpok charoncha alenu ki ammeka anachnu bene briteka. El habbita. Dal kebodenu baggoyim veshiqqetzunu ketumat hannidda. Ad matai uzzeka bashshebi vetifarteka beyad tzar. Hemma yiru veyeboshu veyechattu miggeburatam. Orera geburateka vehoshienu lemaan shemeka. Al yimatu lefaneka telaotenu maher yeqaddemunu rachameka beet tzarotenu. Lo lemaanenu ella lemaanaka peal veal tashchet et zecher sheeritenu. Atta Adonai lo tichla rachameka mimmenni, chasdeka vaamitteka tamid yitzeruni: Zechor rachameka Adonai vachasadeka, ki meolam hemma: Tenu oz lelohim, al yisrael gaavato, veuzzo bashshechaqim. Nora elohim mimmiqdasheka, el yisrael hu noten oz vetaatzumot laam, baruk elohim:

El neqamot Adonai, el neqamot hofia: Hinnase shofet haaretz, hasheb gemul al geim: LaAdonai hayeshua, al ammeka birchateka sela: Adonai tzebaot immanu, misgab lanu elohe yaaqob sela: Adonai tzebaot, ashre adam boteach bak: Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu: Hoshia et ammeka ubarek et nachalateka, ureem venasseem ad haolam: Nafshenu chikketa laAdonai, ezrenu umagginnenu hu: Ki bo yismach libbenu, ki beshem qodsho batachnu: Yehi chasdeka Adonai alenu, kaasher yichalnu lak: Harenu Adonai chasdeka, veyeshaka titten lanu: Quma ezrata lanu, ufedenu lemaan chasdeka: Anochi Adonai elohaka, hamaalka meeretz mitzrayim, harcheb pika vaamalehu: Ashre haam shekacha lo, ashre haam sheAdonai elohayv: Vaani bechasdeka batachti, yagel libbi bishuateka, ashira laAdonai ki gamal alay:
pesukeiDezimra.hashemHuHaElokim:
[[HAL]]Said twice.[[/HAL]]

Adonai hu haelohim, Adonai hu haelohim:

birkotKriatShema.yotzerOhr:
[[HAL]]When beginning Yotzer Or, one touches the tefillin shel yad (Ben Ish Chai, Shemot 1).[[/HAL]]

Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melek haolam, yotzer or ubore choshek ose shalom ubore et hakkol. Hammeir laaretz veladdarim aleha berachamim, ubetubo mechaddesh bechol yom tamid maase bereshit. Ma rabbu maaseka Adonai kullam bechochma asita, malea haaretz qinyaneka. Hammelek hammeromam lebaddo meaz, hammeshubbach vehameforar vehammitnasse mimot olam. Elohe olam, berachameka harabbim rachem alenu, adon uzzenu, tzur misgabbenu, magen yishenu, misgab baadenu. El baruk gadol dea, hechin ufaal zohare chamma. Tob yatzar kabod lishmo, meorot natan sebibot uzzo. Pinnot tzibot qedoshim, romeme shadday, tamid mesapperim kebod el uqedushato. Titbarak Adonai elohenu bashamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat, al kol shebach maase yadeka veal meore or sheyyatzarta hemma yefaaruka sela:
birkotKriatShema.keilBaruch:
Titbarak lanetzach tzurenu malkenu vegoalenu bore qedoshim, yishtabach shimka laad malkenu yotzer mesharetim, vaasher mesharetayv kullam omedim berum olam umashmiim beyira yachad beqol dibre elohim chayyim umelek olam. Kullam ahubim, kullam berurim, kullam gibborim, kullam qedoshim, kullam osim beema ubeyira retzon qonehem, vechullam potechim et pihem biqdusha ubetahora, beshira ubezimra, umebarechin umeshabbechin umefaarin umaqdishin umaaritzin umamlichin et shem hael hammelek haggadol haggibbor vehannora qadosh hu. Vechullam meqabbelim alehem ol malchut shamayim ze mizze, venotenim reshut ze laze lehaqdish leyotzeram benachat ruach besafa berura ubineima qedosha, kullam keechad onim beema, veomerim beyira:

[[HAL]]The qedusha of Yotzer must be said sitting; if one was standing, one should sit (Ben Ish Chai, Shemot 2).[[/HAL]]

Qadosh qadosh qadosh Adonai tzebaot, melo kol haaretz kebodo: Vehaofannim vechayyot haqqodesh berash gadol mitnassim leummat hasserafim, leummatam meshabbechim veomerim: Baruk kebod Adonai mimmeqomo:

Lael baruk, neimot yittenu, lammelek el chay veqayyam, zemirot yomeru vetishbachot yashmiu, ki hu lebaddo marom veqadosh, poel geburot, ose chadashot, baal milchamot, zorea tzedaqot, matzmiach yeshuot, bore refuot, nora tehillot, adon hanniflaot, hammechaddesh betubo bechol yom tamid maase bereshit kaamur: Leose orim gedolim, ki leolam chasdo: Baruk atta Adonai, yotzer hammeorot:
birkotKriatShema.ahavahRabbah:
Ahabat olam ahabtanu Adonai elohenu, chemla gedola viteira chamalta alenu. Abinu malkenu, baabur shimka haggadol ubaabur abotenu shebatechu bak, vattelammedemo chuqqe chayyim laasot retzonka belebab shalem, ken techonnenu abinu, ab harachaman hamerachem, rachem na alenu, veten belibbenu bina lehabin, lehaskil, lishmoa, lilmod ulelammed, lishmor velaasot ulqayyem et kol dibre talmud torateka beahaba:

Vehaer enenu betorateka, vedabbeq libbenu bemitzvoteka, veyached lebabenu leahaba ulyira et shemeka. Lo nebosh velo nikkalem velo nikkashel leolam vaed. Ki beshem qodsheka haggadol haggibbor vehannora batachnu, nagila venismecha bishuateka, verachameka Adonai elohenu vachasadeka harabbim, al yaazbunu netzach sela vaed:

[[HALI]]When one says "mahar vehabe alenu," he places the two sides of the tallit on his shoulders, and when he says "beracha veshalom mehera meearba kanfot kol haaretz," he gathers all four corners of the tallit and holds them in his left hand opposite the heart, since the heart is on the left (Ben Ish Chai, Shemot 5).[[/HALI]] Maher vehabe alenu beracha veshalom mehera mearba kanfot kol haaretz, ushebor ol haggoyim meal tzavvarenu, veholichenu mehera qomemiyyut leartzenu, ki el poel yeshuot atta, ubanu bacharta mikkol am velashon, veqerabtanu malkenu leshimka haggadol beahaba, lehodot lak ulyachedka leyira ulahaba et shemeka. Baruk atta Adonai, habboer beammo yisrael beahaba:
birkotKriatShema.veahavta: Veahabta et Adonai eloheka bechol lebabeka ubechol nafsheka ubechol meodeka. Vehayu haddebarim haelle asher anochi metzavveka hayyom al lebabeka. Veshinnantam lebaneka vedibbarta bam, beshibteka beteka ubelechteka badderek, ubeshochbeka ubequmeka. Uqeshartam leot al yadeka [[HALI]]touches the tefillin shel yad (Ben Ish Chai, Vaera 21).[[/HALI]] vehayu letotafot [[HALI]]touches the tefillin shel rosh.[[/HALI]] ben eneka. Uchetabtam al mezuzot beteka ubishareka:
birkotKriatShema.vehaya: Vehaya im shamoa tishmeu el mitzvotai asher anochi metzavve etkem hayyom, leahaba et Adonai elohekem ulobdo bechol lebabkem ubechol nafshekem. Venatatti metar artzekem beitto yore umalqosh, veasafta deganeka vetiroshka veyitzhareka. Venatatti eseb besadeka libhemteka, veachalta vesabaata. Hishameru lachem pen yifte lebabkem, vesartem vaabadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem. Vechara af Adonai bachem veatzar et hashamayim velo yihye matar, vehaadama lo titten et yebulah, vaabadtem mehera meal haaretz hattoba asher Adonai noten lachem. Vesamtem et debarai elle al lebabkem veal nafshekem, uqeshartem otam leot al yedchem [[HALI]]touches the tefillin shel yad.[[/HALI]] vehayu letotafot ben enekem [[HALI]]touches the tefillin shel rosh.[[/HALI]]. Velimmadtem otam et benekem ledabber bam, beshibteka beteka ubelechteka badderek, ubeshochbeka ubequmeka. Uchetabtam al mezuzot beteka ubishareka. Lemaan yirbu yemekem vime benekem al haadama, asher nishba Adonai laabotekem latet lahem, kime hashamayim al haaretz:
birkotKriatShema.vayomer: Vayyomer Adonai el mosheh lemor: Dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem, veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe bigdehem ledorotam, venatenu al tzitzit hakkanaf petil techelet. Vehaya lachem letzitzit, ureitem oto [[HALI]]look at the tzitzit in your hands, pass them over your eyes, and kiss them twice.[[/HALI]] uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai vaasitem otam, velo taturu acharei lebabkem veacharei enekem [[HALI]]pass the tzitzit over your eyes and kiss them.[[/HALI]] asher attem zonim acharehem. Lemaan tizkeru vaasitem et kol mitzvotai, viheyitem qedoshim lelohekem. Ani Adonai elohekem asher hotzeti etkem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim, ani Adonai elohekem. Emet. (the chazzan repeats) Adonai elohekem emet:
birkotKriatShema.emetVeyatziv:
Veyatziv, venachon, veqayyam, veyashar, veneeman, veahub, vechabib, venechmad, venaim, venora, veaddir, umtuqqan, umqubbal, vetob, veyafe, haddabar hazze alenu leolam vaed.

Emet, elohe olam malkenu tzur yaaqob magen yishenu, ledor vador hu qayyam, ushemo qayyam, vechisso nachon, umalchuto veemunato laad qayyemet, undebarayv chayyim veqayyamim, veneemanim venechemadim laad

[[HAL]]He kisses the tzitzit he was holding, passes them over his eyes, and removes them from his hand (Ben Ish Chai, Shemot 8).[[/HAL]]

uleolme olamim. Al abotenu, alenu veal banenu veal dorotenu veal kol dorot zera yisrael abadeka. Al harishonim veal haacharonim dabar tob veqayyam beemet veemuna, choq velo yaabor. Emet sheatta hu Adonai elohenu velohe abotenu. Malkenu melek abotenu. Goalenu goel abotenu. Yotzrenu tzur yeshuatenu. Podenu umatzzilenu meolam hu shemeka, veen lanu od elohim zulateka sela:

Ezrat abotenu atta hu meolam, magen umoshia lahem velibnehem acharehem bechol dor vador. Berum olam moshabeka, umishpateka, vetzidqateka ad afse aretz, emet ashre ish shessishma lemitzvoteka vetorateka udebarka yasim al libbo. Emet sheatta hu adon leammeka umelek gibbor larib ribam leabot ubanim, emet atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon umibbalaadeka en lanu melek goel umoshia. Emet mimmitzrayim geltanu Adonai elohenu, mibbet abadim peditanu, kol bechorehem haragta, ubechoreka yisrael galta, veyam suf lahem baqata, vezedim tibbata, vididim abru yam. Vayechassu mayim tzarehem echad mehem lo notar. Al zot shibbechu ahubim, veromemu lael, venatenu yedidim zemirot shirot vetishbachot berachot vehodaot lammelek el chay veqayyam, ram venissa, gadol venora, mashpil geim ade aretz, magbiah shefalim ad marom, motzi asirim, pode anavim, ozer dallim, haone leammo yisrael beet shavam elayv.

Tehillot lael elyon goalam, baruk hu umeborak, mosheh ubene yisrael leka anu shira besimcha rabba, veameru chullam: Mi kamoka baelim Adonai, mi kamoka nedar baqodesh, nora tehillot ose fele. Shira chadasha shibbechu geulim leshimka haggadol al sefat hayyam, yachad kullam hodu vehimlichu veameru: Adonai yimlok leolam vaed. Veneemar: Goalenu Adonai tzebaot shemo, qedosh yisrael. Baruk atta Adonai, gaal yisrael:
birkotKriatShema.shemaKavanaNote: Before reciting the Shema, one should intend to fulfill the positive commandment we were commanded, to recite the Shema twice a day, and should also intend to fulfill the commandment of unifying the Name — closing one's eyes with the right hand during the first verse until finishing "Baruch Shem." Here, one says "Shema Yisrael" — meaning, accept these words, understand them, and know them, so that you believe in them: that Hashem is our God, and further, that Hashem is One. In this there is both an acceptance and an acknowledgment of two things: the first is the acceptance of the Kingship of Heaven, in saying "Hashem our God" — acknowledging that we accept His divinity, that He is our God and we are His servants; and the second is the matter of unifying the Name, in saying "Hashem is One" — meaning that He is without any partner.

arvitBlessings.maarivAravim: Baruk atta Adonai, elohenu melek haolam, asher bidbaro maarib arabim bechochma, poteach shearim bitbuna, meshanne ittim, umachalif et hazzemannim, umesadder et hakkochabim bemishmerotehem baraqia, kirtzono. Bore yomam valayla, golel or mippene choshek vechoshek mippene or. Hammaabir yom umebi layla, umabdil ben yom uben layla, Adonai tzebaot shemo: Baruk atta Adonai, hammaarib arabim:
arvitBlessings.ahavatOlam: Ahabat olam bet yisrael ammeka ahabta, tora umitzvot chuqqim umishpatim otanu limmadta, al ken Adonai elohenu, beshochbenu ubequmenu nasiach bechuqqeka, venismach venealoz bedibre talmud torateka umitzvoteka vechuqqoteka leolam vaed, ki hem chayyenu veorek yamenu, ubahem nehge yomam valayla, veahabatka lo tasur mimmennu leolamim: Baruk atta Adonai, oheb et ammo yisrael:
arvitBlessings.emetVeemunah: Veemuna kol zot veqayyam alenu, ki hu Adonai elohenu veen zulato, vaanachnu yisrael ammo. Happodenu miyyad melachim, haggoalenu malkenu mikkaf kol aritzim, hael hannifra lanu mitzarenu, hammeshallem gemul lechol oyebe nafshenu. Hassam nafshenu bachayyim, velo natan lammot raglenu, hammadrichenu al bamot oyebenu, vayyarem qarnenu al kol soneenu. Hael haose lanu neqama befaro, beotot ubemofetim beadmat bene cham. Hammakke beebrato kol bechore mitzrayim, vayyotze et ammo yisrael mittocham lecherut olam. Hammaabir banayv ben gizre yam suf, veet rodefehem veet soneehem bithomot tibba. Rau banim et geburato, shibbechu vehodu lishmo, umalchuto beratzon qibbelu alehem. Mosheh ubene yisrael leka anu shira besimcha rabba, veameru chullam: Mi kamoka baelim Adonai, mi kamoka nedar baqodesh, nora tehillot ose fele. Malchuteka Adonai elohenu rau baneka al hayyam, yachad kullam hodu vehimlichu veameru: Adonai yimlok leolam vaed: Veneemar: Ki fada Adonai et yaaqob, ugealo miyyad chazaq mimmennu: Baruk atta Adonai, gaal yisrael:
arvitBlessings.hashkiveinu: Hashkibenu abinu leshalom, vehaamidenu malkenu lechayyim tobim uleshalom. Ufros alenu sukkat shelomeka, vetaqqenenu malkenu beetza toba millefaneka, vehoshienu mehera lemaan shemeka. Vehagen baadenu, vehaser mealenu makkat oyeb, deber, chereb, choli, tzara, raa, raab, veyagon, umashchit, umaggefa. Shebor vehaser hassatan millefanenu umeacharenu, ubetzel kenafeka tastirenu, ushemor tzetenu uboenu lechayyim tobim uleshalom meatta vead olam. Ki el shomerenu umatzzilenu atta mikkol dabar ra umippachad layla. Baruk atta Adonai, shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen:
arvitBlessings.barchu:
[[NOTE]]The chazzan says:[[/NOTE]] Barechu et Adonai hamborak:

[[NOTE]]The congregation responds:[[/NOTE]] Baruk Adonai hamborak leolam vaed:

[[NOTE]]The chazzan says:[[/NOTE]] Baruk Adonai hamborak leolam vaed:
arvitBlessings.leshemYichud: Leshem yichud qudsha berik hu ushechinteh, bidchilu urechimu, urechimu udchilu, leyachada shem Yud-Qei beVav-Qei beyichuda shelim, beshem kol yisrael, hinne anachnu baim lehitpallel tefillat arbit shettiqqen yaaqob abinu alayv hashalom, im kol hammitzvot hakkelulot bah, letaqqen et shorshah bemaqom elyon, laasot nachat ruach leyotzerenu velaasot retzon boreenu. Vihi noam Adonai elohenu alenu umaase yadenu konena alenu, umaase yadenu konenehu: (said twice)
arvitBlessings.openingVerses: Adonai tzebaot immanu, misgab lanu elohe yaaqob sela. Adonai tzebaot, ashre adam boteach bak. Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu:
arvitBlessings.vehuRachum: Vehu rachum yechapper avon velo yashchit, vehirba lehashib appo velo yair kol chamato. Adonai hoshia, hammelek yaanenu beyom qareenu:

korbanot.elokeinuVelohei: Elohenu velohe abotenu, zochrenu bezikkaron tob millefaneka, ufoqdenu bifqudat yeshua verachamim mishshme shme qedem, uzchor lanu Adonai elohenu ahabat haqqadmonim abraham yitzchaq veyisrael abadeka, et haberit veet hachesed veet hashebua shennishbata leabraham abinu behar hammoriyya, veet haaqeda sheaqad et yitzchaq beno al gabbe hammizbeach kakkatub betorataka:
korbanot.akeida: Vayehi achar haddebarim haelle, vehaelohim nissa et abraham, vayyomer elayv: Abraham, vayyomer hinneni. Vayyomer qach na et binka et yechideka asher ahabta et yitzchaq, velek leka el eretz hammoriyya, vehaalehu sham leola al achad heharim asher omar eleka. Vayyashkem abraham babboqer, vayyachabosh et chamoro, vayyiqqach et shene nearayv itto veet yitzchaq beno, vayebaqqa atze ola, vayyaqam vayyelek el hammaqom asher amar lo haelohim. Bayyom hasheliishi vayyissa abraham et enayv, vayyar et hammaqom merachoq. Vayyomer abraham el nearayv, shebu lachem po im hachamor, vaani vehannaar nelcha ad ko, venishtachaveh venashuba alekem. Vayyiqqach abraham et atze haola, vayyasem al yitzchaq beno, vayyiqqach beyado et haesh veet hammaakelet, vayyelechu shenehem yachdav. Vayyomer yitzchaq el abraham abiv vayyomer abi, vayyomer hinenni beni, vayyomer hinne haesh vehaetzim, veayye hasse leola. Vayyomer abraham, elohim yireh lo hasse leola beni, vayyelechu shenehem yachdav. Vayyabou el hammaqom asher amar lo haelohim, vayyiben sham abraham et hammizbeach, vayyaaroch et haetzim, vayyaaqod et yitzchaq beno, vayyasem oto al hammizbeach mimmaal laetzim. Vayyishlach abraham et yado, vayyiqqach et hammaakelet lishchot et beno. Vayyiqra elayv malak Adonai min hashamayim, vayyomer abraham abraham, vayyomer hinenni. Vayyomer al tishlach yadeka el hannaar veal taas lo meuma, ki atta yadati ki yere elohim atta, velo chasachta et binka et yechideka mimmenni. Vayyissa abraham et enayv, vayyar vehinne ayil achar neechaz bassebach beqarnayv, vayyelek abraham vayyiqqach et haayil, vayyaalehu leola tachat beno. Vayyiqra abraham shem hammaqom hahu Adonai yireh, asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yeraeh. Vayyiqra malak Adonai el abraham shenit min hashamayim. Vayyomer, bi nishbati neum Adonai, ki yaan asher asita et haddabar hazze, velo chasachta et binka et yechideka. Ki barek abarekeka, veharba arbe et zaraka kekochebe hashamayim vechachol asher al sefat hayyam, veyirash zaraka et shaar oyebayv. Vehitbarechu bezaraka kol goye haaretz, eqeb asher shamata beqoli. Vayyashob abraham el nearayv, vayyaqumu vayyelechu yachdav el beer shaba, vayyesheb abraham bibeer shaba:
korbanot.akeidaYehiRatzon: Yehi ratzon millefaneka Adonai elohenu velohe abotenu, shettitmalle rachamim alenu, ubechen berob rachameka tizkor lanu aqedato shel yitzchaq abinu ben abraham abinu alayv hashalom, keillu efro tzabur umunach al gabbe hammizbeach, vetabbit beefro lerachem alenu, ulbattel mealenu kol gezerot qashot veraot, utezakkenu lashub bitshuba shelema lefaneka, vetatzzilenu miyyetzer hara umikkol chet veavon, vetaarik yamenu battob ushenotenu banneimim:
korbanot.ribonoShelOlam:
Ribbono shel olam, kemo shekabash abraham abinu et rachamayv laasot retzonka belebab shalem, ken yichbeshu rachameka et kaaseka, veyiggolu rachameka al middoteka, vetitnaheg immanu Adonai elohenu bemiddat hachesed ubemiddat harachamim, vetikkanes lanu lifnim mishshurat haddin, ubetubka haggadol yashub charon appeka, meammeka umeiraka umeartzeka umennachalateka, veqayyem lanu Adonai elohenu et haddabar shehibtachtanu betorataka al yede mosheh abdeka kaamur: Vezacharti et beriti yaaqob, veaf et beriti yitzchaq, veaf et beriti abraham ezkor, vehaaretz ezkor: Veneemar: Veaf gam zot, bihyotam beeretz oyebehem, lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam, lehafer beriti ittam, ki ani Adonai elohehem: Vezacharti lahem berit rishonim, asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim leene haggoyim, lihyot lahem lelohim, ani Adonai: Veneemar: Veshab Adonai eloheka et shebuteka verichameka, veshab veqibbetzeka mikkol haammim asher hefitzeka Adonai eloheka shamma: Im yihye niddachaka biqtze hashamayim, missham yeqabbetzeka Adonai eloheka, umissham yiqqacheka: Vehebiaka Adonai eloheka el haaretz asher yareshu abateka virishtah, veheteboka vehirbeka meabateka: Veneemar al yede nebieka: Adonai channenu leka qivvinu, heye zeroam labbeqarim, af yeshuatenu beet tzara: Veneemar: Veet tzara hi leyaaqob, umimmenna yivvashea: Veneemar: Bechol tzaratam lo tzar, umalak panayv hoshiam, beahabato ubechemlato hu gealam, vayenattelem vayenasseem kol yeme olam: Veneemar:

Mi el kamoka [[HALI]]el[[/HALI]] nose avon [[HALI]]rachum[[/HALI]] veober al pesha [[HALI]]vechannun[[/HALI]] lisherit nachalato [[HALI]]erek[[/HALI]] lo hecheziq laad appo [[HALI]]appayim[[/HALI]] ki chafetz chesed hu [[HALI]]verab chesed[[/HALI]]: Yashub yerachamenu [[HALI]]veemet[[/HALI]] yichbosh avonotenu [[HALI]]notzer chesed[[/HALI]] vetashlik bimtzulot yam kol chattotam [[HALI]]laalafim[[/HALI]]: Titten emet leyaaqob [[HALI]]nose avon[[/HALI]] chesed leabraham [[HALI]]vafesha[[/HALI]] asher nishbata laabotenu [[HALI]]vechattaa[[/HALI]] mime qedem [[HALI]]venaqqe[[/HALI]]: Veneemar: Vahabiotim el har qodshi, vesimmachtim bebet tefillati, olotehem vezibchehem leratzon al mizbechi, ki beti bet tefilla yiqqare lechol haammim:
korbanot.parashatHatamid: Vayedabber Adonai el mosheh lemor: Tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem, et qorbani lachmi leishshai reach nichochi tishmeru lehaqrib li bemoado.
